test_title: PYST 12: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

His sudden resignation left the company __in a very difficult situation and to have to make a hard decision__ as they scrambled to find a replacement.

options.text: between a rock and a hard place

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"between a rock and a hard place"** means being faced with two difficult choices or situations. (कठिन परिस्थितियों के बीच फंसा होना)

 
 
• **Example: **The company was between a rock and a hard place, needing to cut costs without laying off employees.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **in the dark** (अंधेरे में होना): Not knowing something or being uninformed about a situation.

 
 
• **Example:** She was completely in the dark about the changes happening in the company.
 
 
 
• **with a silver lining** (हर बुरी स्थिति में कुछ अच्छा होना): Finding something positive in a negative situation.
 
 
• **Example:** Even though they lost the game, with a silver lining, they learned what to improve for the next match.
 
 
 
• **on cloud nine** (बहुत खुश होना): Being extremely happy and joyful.
 
 
• **Example:** She was on cloud nine after receiving the job offer.
 
 

33:T725,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
